gen.title: From early vision research to modern language learning
gen.orderNote: Follow the article order from early vision to today's learning tools

steps.label: ImageNet database is launched
steps.quote: A pivotal moment came in 2009, when Fei-Fei Li, supported by an NSF Faculty Early Career Development award, and her team launched ImageNet

steps.label: Graphics processors speed up learning
steps.quote: By the 2010s, researchers discovered how to use high-performance graphics-processing units to dramatically improve the speed and accuracy

steps.label: Language app launches for learners
steps.quote: Launched in 2011, Duolingo is rooted in decades of NSF-supported linguistic and AI-driven learning research.

steps.label: Virtual teachers advance learning experiences
steps.quote: including virtual teachers (both digital and robotic) that incorporate speech, gesture, gaze and facial expression.
